releaseNotes:
OmniControl Suite v7.0.2 — FrameGen Layout Fix & Zero-Lag Input Engine:
- Fixed UI Card Overlap: Repositioned OmniFrameGen card with clean vertical spacing (y=196) and enabled smooth AutoScroll so telemetry cards never overlap.
- Zero-Lag Presentation Engine: Engages DwmEnableMMCSS, DwmFlush, UltraLowLatencyMode (2), MaxPreRenderedFrames (1), and 1.0ms MMIO precision timer to eliminate input latency during 2X/3X frame generation.
- Automatic High Process Priority for active games and Lossless Scaling.
